assumptions.exact_statement: A separately governed source, classification and derivation manifest can detect material mutation, substitution or unsupported provenance before public release.

systems: snapshot capture, classification, derivation and record indexing
exclusions: Upstream facts whose original response bytes were not retained

stewardship.accountability: Freeze the manifest, retain hostile fixtures and seek independent reproduction.

affected.description: People relying on public evidence claims

benefited.description: People relying on public evidence claims

evidence_refs.relevance: Records current internal containments and their required falsification tests.

counterevidence_refs.relevance: Five malicious snapshots passed the earlier global build.

challenge.testable_prediction: Every manifest mutation, source substitution and unrecomputed derived value is rejected with a specific error.
challenge.observation_that_would_falsify: Any declared neighbouring mutation passes a clean-checkout build against the frozen release.
challenge.test_method: Run the frozen malicious snapshots plus generated neighbouring attacks under independent review.

decision_dependencies.consequence_if_wrong: Mutated or unsupported claims may be presented as decision-grade evidence.

public_disposition.plain_language: Hypothesis: the new evidence controls are intended to reject source, classification and derivation corruption, but independent reproduction is still outstanding.
public_disposition.rationale: The design claim is useful only when paired with its failure history and open test.

assumptions.exact_statement: Every public rendering of a claim must keep its evidence class, timing basis and publication eligibility adjacent enough to survive crop, reflow, print, copy and export.

systems: cards, charts, comparison views, print, copy and machine exports

stewardship.accountability: Block public release when context can be separated from a claim.

evidence_refs.relevance: Records class borrowing, hidden clocks and cropped action-boundary attacks.

challenge.review_question: Can any supported viewport or export preserve the claim while losing its epistemic or authority qualifier?
challenge.process: Review cards, SVG endpoints, compare, mobile, 400 percent zoom, print, copy and machine exports.
challenge.decision_rule: Block the affected surface if the qualifier is missing, borrowed or separable from the claim.

decision_dependencies.consequence_if_wrong: A bounded claim may be consumed as observed fact or authorised instruction.

public_disposition.plain_language: Safeguard: a number or action label must travel with the context needed to interpret it correctly.
public_disposition.rationale: Correct source data cannot protect a reader after the interface strips away its meaning.

assumptions.exact_statement: Point-level source binding, role-aware timing and retained execution evidence can make the timing assessment adequate for bounded publication decisions.

systems: external observations, derivations, assessments and scoped exports
exclusions: Sources with unresolved acquisition or release intervals

stewardship.accountability: Attack point joins, clocks, role assignments, operands and export boundaries.

evidence_refs.relevance: Documents internally contained timing attacks and the remaining independent-review requirement.

counterevidence_refs.relevance: A green first implementation hid multiple timing and record failures.

challenge.testable_prediction: Every governed point reports its own source binding, role, interval, lineage and publication eligibility without borrowing another point's state.
challenge.observation_that_would_falsify: A role swap, omitted operand, invented clock, point substitution or dangling export passes the frozen challenge pack.
challenge.test_method: Generate point-targeted mutations and compare the assessment bundle with independently recomputed source and derivation records.

decision_dependencies.consequence_if_wrong: A stale, unresolved or misbound point may appear current and actionable.

public_disposition.plain_language: Hypothesis: point-level timing controls can support bounded publication decisions once independent attacks reproduce their behaviour.
public_disposition.rationale: Internal test coverage is evidence about implementation behaviour, not proof that the model is complete.

assumptions.exact_statement: A stateful transition resolver with independent safety, candidate-phase, concurrent-duty and exit axes can prevent gate results from causing unsafe lifecycle changes.

systems: condition evaluation and intervention lifecycle proposals

stewardship.accountability: Exercise every lifecycle transition, conflict and concurrent duty against prior state.

affected.description: People responsible for safe service transitions

burdened.description: People responsible for safe service transitions

evidence_refs.relevance: Defines counterexamples for missing prepare, hidden concurrency, stateless withdrawal and conflicting exits.

challenge.testable_prediction: Every reachable combination yields explicit safety, candidate-phase, concurrent-duty and exit outputs without automatic activation or withdrawal.
challenge.observation_that_would_falsify: Any lifecycle matrix row silently withdraws support, hides a concurrent duty or graduates through a conflict.
challenge.test_method: Exhaustively evaluate the lifecycle transition matrix, including unknown and conflicting predicate states.

decision_dependencies.consequence_if_wrong: A computed result could suppress needed support or conceal a safety duty.

public_disposition.plain_language: Hypothesis: the transition resolver can expose safe candidate states and concurrent duties without activating or withdrawing anything.
public_disposition.rationale: The model is testable, but it remains a proposal generator rather than an authority.

assumptions.exact_statement: Predicate truth, condition eligibility and legitimate authority are separate states, and no repository record may infer the latter from either of the former.

systems: conditions, options, dashboards, exports and public communications

stewardship.accountability: Keep every repository output proposal-only and verify the external commitment boundary separately.

affected.description: Legitimate authorities accountable for real decisions

burdened.description: Legitimate authorities accountable for real decisions

evidence_refs.relevance: Shows calculated gate truth and synthetic commitments can masquerade as permission.

challenge.review_question: Could any reader or downstream system interpret this output as permission to act?
challenge.process: Trace every state name, action phrase, export field and lifecycle edge through public and machine surfaces.
challenge.decision_rule: Block output that collapses truth, eligibility, commitment or authority into one state.

decision_dependencies.consequence_if_wrong: A software assertion could masquerade as a lawful and legitimate mandate.

public_disposition.plain_language: Safeguard: a condition can evaluate as true and an option can be eligible while nobody has authorised, funded or activated it.
public_disposition.rationale: The distinction is a permanent safety boundary, not an empirical forecast.

assumptions.exact_statement: Any real intervention requires separately verified, mutually scoped and unexpired authority, consent, funding, service capacity, help, appeal, expiry and stop mechanisms before activation.

stewardship.accountability: Define the external commitment envelope and prevent partial bundles from appearing ready.

affected.description: People affected by intervention delivery or withdrawal
People accountable for funded and safe delivery

benefited.description: People affected by intervention delivery or withdrawal

burdened.description: People affected by intervention delivery or withdrawal
People accountable for funded and safe delivery

evidence_refs.relevance: Shows that free text and one verified authority cannot establish complete operational readiness.

challenge.review_question: Is every required commitment independently verified for the same actor, scope, population and validity interval?
challenge.process: Verify each commitment with its accountable actor and test missing, mismatched, expired, disputed and revoked states.
challenge.decision_rule: Remain proposal-only if any commitment is absent, mismatched, expired, disputed or unverifiable.

decision_dependencies.consequence_if_wrong: A partially ready intervention could expose people to service failure without remedy.

public_disposition.plain_language: Safeguard: no action is ready until every required actor and commitment is independently verified for the same scope and time.
public_disposition.rationale: A partial bundle can be structurally neat and operationally unsafe.

assumptions.exact_statement: Within binding rights and law, affected and burdened parties should have decisive standing over whether an intervention's distribution of benefits, burdens and residual risks is acceptable.

systems: option design, consent, dissent, appeal and governance
exclusions: Choices prohibited by binding rights or law

stewardship.accountability: Commission a legitimate process and preserve disagreement rather than declaring consensus.

affected.description: People experiencing direct effects and spillovers
Institutions carrying delivery duties and costs

benefited.description: People experiencing direct effects and spillovers

burdened.description: People experiencing direct effects and spillovers
Institutions carrying delivery duties and costs

evidence_refs.relevance: Demonstrates that one actor cannot declare another actor ready or agreed.

challenge.review_question: Who has standing to accept this distribution of benefit, burden and residual risk?
challenge.process: Co-design the decision process with affected parties, publish representation gaps and preserve dissent, veto and appeal routes.
challenge.decision_rule: Do not describe a tradeoff as accepted until the mandated process records scoped agreement and unresolved dissent.

decision_dependencies.consequence_if_wrong: Project authors could substitute their values for those carrying the consequences.

public_disposition.plain_language: Value choice: people carrying an intervention's consequences should have decisive standing over whether its tradeoffs are acceptable.
public_disposition.rationale: The project must expose this normative commitment instead of presenting it as a discovered fact.

assumptions.exact_statement: The project does not yet know whether candidate representatives, mandates, consent, lawfulness, burden allocation or delivery capacity are legitimate and real for any operational scope.

systems: external legitimacy, commitment and real-world delivery

stewardship.accountability: Keep external residuals visible and seek evidence from the people and institutions involved.

affected.description: People the project may claim to represent or support
Institutions whose mandate, capacity or commitments would be required

benefited.description: People the project may claim to represent or support

burdened.description: People the project may claim to represent or support
Institutions whose mandate, capacity or commitments would be required

counterevidence_refs.relevance: Explicitly states that code cannot establish legitimacy, consent, representation, lawfulness, burden fairness or real delivery.

challenge.review_question: What evidence would the affected people and accountable external institutions accept as establishing each residual for this exact scope?
challenge.process: Commission independent legal, legitimacy, representation, commitment and delivery reviews with affected-party challenge routes.
challenge.decision_rule: Keep each residual unknown and block operational claims until its accountable external reviewer records a scoped determination.

decision_dependencies.consequence_if_wrong: Repository completeness could be mistaken for legitimacy, lawfulness or real delivery capacity.

public_disposition.plain_language: Unknown: this repository has not established real mandates, legitimacy, consent, lawfulness, fair burden sharing or delivery capacity.
public_disposition.rationale: These are external social and institutional facts that code cannot self-attest.
